baseline_regression.classification: Expected baseline failures; not final acceptance. New menu mocks bound reads rather than permit an infinite menu. Later final suite adds the real output-menu integration case for 20 cases.

A01.evidence: Real Run-TUI reads Quit once, renders menu once and continues its caller. Native PS1 on both hosts exits zero; unchanged BAT executes the split marker in its retained PowerShell caller after Quit.

A02.evidence: Missing source selection through real menu/prompt stays absent; existing source content is preserved; explicit output menu creates a nested directory and saves only that selection. Menu parameter regressions permit CreateIfMissing only for output.

A03.evidence: Blank/whitespace/quoted whitespace cancels; literal bracket and Finnish/German/CJK file/folder/output names resolve exactly. Wildcard-lookalike neighbor and file/source/output sentinels remain unchanged. Mocked access denial and real file-blocked creation report errors and permit cancellation.

A04.evidence: Actual human Explorer double-click/menu/Quit observation requested asynchronously; response pending. Native desktop control disabled in this session. Automated/native redirected stdin does not pass this criterion.
